items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: They had a, what's this great band up in Donisonville? Claiborne. ... I knew a couple of the fellas.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. They had a, what's this great band up in Donisonville? Claiborne.

Yeah. I believe you heard them. Yeah. Yeah. They had a band band. They had a little band in Napoleonville. I knew a couple of the fellas. Trombone played by the name of Lewis Hines. Cornet player by the name of, God, it's been so long though. Really that thing kind of slipped me up.
